note: The fenced files are lib.rs, which registers the new launch_nonce module, and semantic_index.rs, whose ONNX Runtime pre-validation now binds the runtime through the file that was hashed; no search, ranking, chunking or embedding code changes, so every ranked row must stay byte-identical to the committed reference. Moves to subc-protocol 0.27.0: the daemon launch nonce is read once through subc_os::launch_nonce() before anything spawns and removed from AFT's environment, call_key and schema_pin are decoded and validated on tool calls, and bash tasks record their call key. Adds regression tests pinning read to the current on-disk bytes, and loads the pinned ONNX Runtime through the same open file its sha256 was taken from.
